items.title: Dejounte Murray Trades, and Concerning Contracts of the 2026 Offseason | Third Apron Podcast
items.body_excerpt: Dejounte Murray requested a trade from the New Orleans Pelicans, so we go over potential suitors and fake trades for him. We also take stock of some of the biggest contracts given out in the summer. You can follow Yossi on: Twitter: https://twitter.com/YossiGozlan BlueSky:…
